name: x3d-static/v2
purpose: x3d-static/v1 tightened by the external accountability review of 18 Nov 2026: every required pass must come from the named loomkit instrument or a project gate run through `command` (no hand-declared pass), traps must have run at least the 11 original rule ids, and the fold-back must be target-bound (applied to a clean clone of the real target at a named base SHA, with the target's own regression command run before and after). Accepting means 'the files hold and the fold-back holds on its target'; it says nothing about how the scene draws.
limitations: Static profile: Behaviour (real browser), Eyes (frames + the user's eye) and Host (strict policy copy) did not run, so 'valid is not visible' still applies (law 2).
A target-bound fold-back shows the patch applies to and keeps green one named base commit; it does not show the knowledge helps a later, independent task (that needs a held-out comparison).
Unsigned receipt: it shows drift; it does not authenticate authorship. Origin typing closes the `loom record` path to a measured pass, not a hand-edited JSON file.
